independence: Each judge receives only the screenplay-only packet, the pre-frozen six-scene packet, and this evaluation instruction stripped of hidden-plan fields.
Judges must not search Literary OS project/GitHub, request hidden architecture, inspect prior scores, or view other judges.
Same-session/internal evaluator results are hidden from judges.
judge_pass_rule: whole_episode_mean >=7.0 AND scene_sample_mean >=7.0 AND CHARACTER_VOICE mean >=6.5 AND KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS mean >=6.5 AND no confirmed critical violation.
aggregate_pass_rule: At least 2 of 3 judges PASS; pooled median whole-episode axis score >=7.0; pooled median scene-axis score >=7.0; no critical violation confirmed independently by >=2 judges.
no_posthoc_rule: No score threshold, scene sample, candidate text, or critical-violation definition may change after first external judge output.
claim_boundary: External blind PASS would qualify R76-VP-B1 as a virtual-provider broadcast-scale literary candidate. It would not equal actual OpenAI API validation, Operational Level-3, Production promotion, or R140.
